Description: This recall involves all Vanderhall model years 2024, 2025, and 2026 Brawley GTS electric recreational off highway vehicles. The vehicles come in Emerald Green, Ida Rose, Ivory White, Jean Grey, Obsidian Black, and Royal Blue. The VIN Numbers for the affected vehicles range from XXXXXXXXXXXXX4933 - XXXXXXXXXXXXX6153 and can be found under the dashboard on the driver's side of the vehicle.
Title: Vanderhall North America Recalls Brawley GTS Electric Recreational Off Highway Vehicles (ROVs) Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard
ConsumerContact: Vanderhall North America, LLC by email at inquiry@vanderhallusa.com or online at https://dealer.vanderhallusa.com/contact, https://portal.vanderhallusa.com/safety_notices, under the name of "Vanderhall North America, LLC Recalls Motor Software Update" for more information.

Products.Name: Vanderhall Brawley GTS electric recreational off highway vehicles

Images.Caption: Recalled Brawley GTS Electric Recreational Off Highway Vehicle
The VIN is visible underneath the driver-side dashboard, left of the foot pedals

Injuries.Name: The firm has received one report of a vehicle unexpectedly accelerating. No injuries have been reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Vanderhall North America, LLC, of Provo, Utah

Retailers.Name: Vanderhall North America dealers in Utah, Ohio, Michigan, Texas, Montana, North Carolina, Oklahoma, and Arizona, from April 2024 through June 2026 for about $50,000.

Hazards.Name: The recalled recreational off highway vehicle can maintain speed or accelerate when the accelerator pedal is released, posing a risk of serious injury or death from a crash hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using their vehicles immediately and contact Vanderhall North America for instructions on how to update their vehicles to firmware version 7.1.0 through the Vanderhall customer mobile app. The updated software was released on April 15, 2026, and can be identified by Vanderhall logo. Owners requiring assistance updating their firmware should contact their dealer or Vanderhall directly for assistance.
